name: 07-look-down
prompt: Use the supplied ivory robot master as character reference. Create a pixel-art sprite sheet, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of six equally spaced square cells. One complete robot HEAD ONLY per cell, perfectly front-facing. Lock ivory casing, ears, silhouette, head scale, head center, eye socket positions and tiny smile identically in all cells. Preserve charcoal face and turquoise eyes with dark pupils and tiny highlights. Animate gaze by moving BOTH dark pupils and iris details inside eye boundaries together, visibly and coherently toward targets; no cross-eyed pupils. Eyes remain OPEN; looking down is NOT closing eyelids. No neck, body, text, arrows, labels, UI, outlines around cells or extraneous objects. 15 percent transparent padding inside each cell so ears never touch cell borders. Sharp square pixels, solid limited colors, no blur, glow, halo, gradients, shadows or black painted background. GENUINELY transparent alpha background. Read six frames left to right, top row then bottom row. Directions are from the VIEWER'S screen perspective. DOWNWARD GAZE sequence. Frame 1: both pupils distinctly LOW CENTER, looking at a task directly BELOW the robot. Frame 2: both pupils LOW and a little to viewer RIGHT. Frame 3: both pupils LOW and far to viewer RIGHT, unmistakably down-right. Frame 4: back to LOW CENTER. Frame 5: both pupils LOW and a little to viewer LEFT. Frame 6: both pupils LOW and far to viewer LEFT, unmistakably down-left. All six frames look DOWN; none look straight ahead or up. Keep eye ring outlines fixed and show more turquoise above dark pupils than below. Clear readable gaze direction is the highest priority.
